memoryBuilder.verseText: Listening to God is better than any gift you can bring Him.

sequence.prompt: What happened with King Saul? Put it in order.

items.label: The people asked for a king
God gave them Saul, who looked kingly
Saul did most of what God said
Saul made excuses instead of obeying

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: One who looked like other nations' kings
That is not obeying at all
One who would truly listen to God

application.question: Saul did the easy parts and skipped the hard one. Where do you do most of a job but not all?
application.followUp: Saul even had a religious-sounding excuse ready. God is not after actions that look good — He is after a heart that listens. Obey all the way.
